WITH as_at AS ( SELECT DATE('${asAtDate}') AS d, DATE('${asAtDate}') = CURDATE() AS is_today ), par_band AS ( SELECT 1 AS id, 'Normal' AS name, 0 AS min_dpd, 30 AS max_dpd UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Watch', 31, 90 UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Substandard', 91, 180 UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Doubtful', 181, 365 UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Loss', 366, NULL ), scope AS ( SELECT ml.id AS loan_id, ml.grace_on_arrears_ageing AS grace FROM m_office mo JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(mo.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') JOIN m_client mc ON mc.office_id = ounder.id JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.client_id = mc.id CROSS JOIN as_at p WHERE mo.id = ${officeId} AND ( (p.is_today AND ml.loan_status_id = 300) OR (NOT p.is_today AND ml.loan_status_id IN (300, 600, 601, 602, 700) AND ml.disbursedon_date <= p.d AND (ml.closedon_date IS NULL OR ml.closedon_date > p.d) AND (ml.writtenoffon_date IS NULL OR ml.writtenoffon_date > p.d)) ) ), live AS ( SELECT t.id, t.loan_id, t.transaction_type_enum AS type, t.principal_portion_derived AS p, t.interest_portion_derived AS i FROM scope s JOIN m_loan_transaction t ON t.loan_id = s.loan_id CROSS JOIN as_at p WHERE NOT p.is_today AND t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.transaction_type_enum IN (2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 28) AND t.transaction_date <= p.d ), paid AS ( SELECT loan_id, SUM(COALESCE(p, 0)) AS p, SUM(COALESCE(i, 0)) AS i FROM live WHERE type IN (2, 5, 8, 28) GROUP BY loan_id ), alloc AS ( SELECT mp.loan_repayment_schedule_id AS sid, SUM(COALESCE(mp.principal_portion_derived, 0)) AS p, SUM(COALESCE(mp.interest_portion_derived, 0)) AS i, SUM(COALESCE(mp.fee_charges_portion_derived, 0)) AS f, SUM(COALESCE(mp.penalty_charges_portion_derived, 0)) AS pen FROM live JOIN m_loan_transaction_repayment_schedule_mapping mp ON mp.loan_transaction_id = live.id GROUP BY mp.loan_repayment_schedule_id ), charge_waived AS ( SELECT rs.id AS sid, SUM(IF(c.is_penalty = 0, pb.amount, 0)) AS f, SUM(IF(c.is_penalty = 1, pb.amount, 0)) AS pen FROM live JOIN m_loan_charge_paid_by pb ON pb.loan_transaction_id = live.id JOIN m_loan_charge c ON c.id = pb.loan_charge_id AND c.is_active = 1 JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = c.loan_id AND c.due_for_collection_as_of_date > rs.fromdate AND c.due_for_collection_as_of_date <= rs.duedate WHERE live.type = 9 GROUP BY rs.id ), written_off AS ( SELECT DISTINCT loan_id FROM live WHERE type = 6 ), instalment_due AS ( SELECT rs.loan_id, rs.duedate, COALESCE(rs.principal_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.p, 0) - IF(wo.loan_id IS NULL, 0, COALESCE(rs.principal_writtenoff_derived, 0)) AS principal_due, COALESCE(rs.interest_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.i, 0) - IF(wo.loan_id IS NULL, 0, COALESCE(rs.interest_writtenoff_derived, 0)) AS interest_due, COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.f, 0) - COALESCE(w.f, 0) - IF(wo.loan_id IS NULL, 0, COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0)) AS fee_due, COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.pen, 0) - COALESCE(w.pen, 0) - IF(wo.loan_id IS NULL, 0, COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0)) AS penalty_due FROM scope s JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = s.loan_id CROSS JOIN as_at p LEFT JOIN alloc a ON a.sid = rs.id LEFT JOIN charge_waived w ON w.sid = rs.id LEFT JOIN written_off wo ON wo.loan_id = rs.loan_id WHERE NOT p.is_today AND rs.duedate < DATE_SUB(p.d, INTERVAL COALESCE(s.grace, 0) DAY) ), as_at_aging AS ( SELECT loan_id, SUM(IF(ROUND(principal_due + interest_due + fee_due + penalty_due, 2) > 0, principal_due, 0)) AS principal_overdue, SUM(IF(ROUND(principal_due + interest_due + fee_due + penalty_due, 2) > 0, interest_due, 0)) AS interest_overdue, MIN(IF(ROUND(principal_due + interest_due + fee_due + penalty_due, 2) > 0, duedate, NULL)) AS overdue_since FROM instalment_due GROUP BY loan_id ), aging AS ( SELECT laa.loan_id, ml.principal_repaid_derived AS principal_paid, ml.interest_repaid_derived AS interest_paid, laa.principal_overdue_derived AS principal_overdue, laa.interest_overdue_derived AS interest_overdue, DATEDIFF(p.d, laa.overdue_since_date_derived) AS dpd FROM scope s JOIN m_loan_arrears_aging laa ON laa.loan_id = s.loan_id JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.id = s.loan_id CROSS JOIN as_at p WHERE p.is_today UNION ALL SELECT a.loan_id, COALESCE(pd.p, 0), COALESCE(pd.i, 0), a.principal_overdue, a.interest_overdue, DATEDIFF(p.d, a.overdue_since) FROM as_at_aging a LEFT JOIN paid pd ON pd.loan_id = a.loan_id CROSS JOIN as_at p WHERE a.overdue_since IS NOT NULL ) SELECT concat(repeat("..", ((LENGTH(ounder.`hierarchy`) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ounder.`hierarchy`, '.', '')) - 1))), ounder.`name`) as "Office/Branch", ifnull(cur.display_symbol, ml.currency_code) as Currency, mc.account_no as "Client Account No.", mc.display_name AS "Client Name", ml.account_no AS "Account Number", ml.principal_amount AS "Loan Amount", ml.principal_disbursed_derived AS "Original Principal", ml.interest_charged_derived AS "Original Interest", ag.principal_paid AS "Principal Paid", ag.interest_paid AS "Interest Paid", ag.principal_overdue AS "Principal Overdue", ag.interest_overdue AS "Interest Overdue", ag.dpd as "Days in Arrears",
IF(ag.dpd<7, '<1', IF(ag.dpd<8, ' 1', IF(ag.dpd<15, '2', IF(ag.dpd<22, ' 3', IF(ag.dpd<29, ' 4', IF(ag.dpd<36, ' 5', IF(ag.dpd<43, ' 6', IF(ag.dpd<50, ' 7', IF(ag.dpd<57, ' 8', IF(ag.dpd<64, ' 9', IF(ag.dpd<71, '10', IF(ag.dpd<78, '11', IF(ag.dpd<85, '12', '12+')))))))))))) )AS "Weeks In Arrears Band",
IF(ag.dpd<31, '0 - 30', IF(ag.dpd<61, '30 - 60', IF(ag.dpd<91, '60 - 90', IF(ag.dpd<181, '90 - 180', IF(ag.dpd<361, '180 - 360', '> 360'))))) AS "Days in Arrears Band", par.name AS "PAR Category"
FROM aging ag JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.id = ag.loan_id JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = mc.office_id LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.code = ml.currency_code LEFT JOIN par_band par ON ag.dpd >= par.min_dpd AND (par.max_dpd IS NULL OR ag.dpd <= par.max_dpd) WHERE (${parCategory} = -1 OR par.id = ${parCategory}) ORDER BY ounder.hierarchy, ifnull(cur.display_symbol, ml.currency_code), ml.account_no
